c.1953
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
SAINT FELIX CAPUCHIN FRIARY HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
Blessed be God in all His Designs!
God bless you Miss Muriel: - you and yours.
Many thanks for your kind favor just Rec'd, noted. I am sending you the Cert. for Helen Mayland. I think she needs it especially from your letter. In the mean time and till I get up a little better with my correspondence, best regards and God holy blessing to all the others - your dear Father especially. I do hope with you, that with the warmer Spring his health and spirits bloom up again and that things in general pick up in his favor.
I almost forgot to congratulate you on your February suc- cess, etc. Deo gratias. Please pardon haste and brevity. Hope for improvement in future.
9:45 P.M.
Very sincerely yours in Christ, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. Praised be Jesus Christ!
